items.title: Tom Albert Interview, 1962-05-07
items.q: I played one or two jobs. They had the band, but sometimes the fellow would get on a drunk, they'd come and get me.

ctx.x: I played one or two jobs. They had the band, but sometimes the fellow would get on a drunk, they'd come and get me. Well which T.O. was that?
I never can keep them straight. There's three of them I know. Well the old man, old man T.O.
